title: Summarise a document
summary: Summarise a document at a chosen length, with key points.

inputs.text: The 2023 library survey received 412 responses. Most respondents visit monthly. The main request was longer weekend opening hours. Satisfaction with staff was high, at 91 percent. Wi-Fi reliability was the most common complaint. The board will consider Sunday opening in March.

sections.use: Summarise a document (a report, notes or an article) in short, medium or long form, with up to eight key points.
sections.exclusions: Not a translation, critique or answer to a question; use the matching blocks. No outside knowledge is added.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 2,048 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Input up to 40,000 characters. Word limits (80, 200, 400) are instructions to the model.
sections.missing_data: An empty or near-empty document gives a one-sentence summary saying so and few or no points.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

outputs.key_points: Up to eight key points, each a short string.
